name: Aperture
description: A skill for AI agents that curate better daily reports. Scans source front pages, diffs them against yesterday, prescreens with a weighted profile, reviews with an LLM, deduplicates, publishes, and evolves the profile from user feedback. All decisions are append-only to a tape for audit and replay.

APERTURE_LLM_API_KEY.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible LLM provider used in the review stage. Optional; the pipeline runs in rule-only dry mode without it.

APERTURE_LLM_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible LLM provider. Optional; defaults to the provider's standard endpoint.

APERTURE_LLM_MODEL.description: Model name for review. Optional; defaults to a sensible provider model.
